text:
Maya: Quick sync on a small pricing experiment: propose a "Starter (slabless)" tier — no monthly slabs, flat per-1k token price, optional surge add-on credits. Want to validate launch criteria and constraints.
Ross: Sounds promising for SMBs and small dev teams. Q: abuse mitigation? Need to avoid unlimited bursts.
Maya: Not unlimited. Plan: per-minute token QPS cap + soft throttles; surge pack purchase to extend throughput. Also usage alerts and automatic downgrade flows for suspicious accounts.
Claire: Revenue guardrails required. How does ARPU look vs current Starter? Without slabs churn risk is higher. Need a minimum list price and assumptions on elasticity.
Maya: Initial modeling: $0.90 / 1k tokens, surge pack $99 for 1M tokens over 30 days. Pilot ARPU estimate ~$120/mo.
Sanjay: On infra: surge packs + soft caps straightforward. Harder: routing customers to Dedicated based on SLA flags — will need a runtime routing tag.
Eli: For pilots, we should offer surge packs as opt-in and hold invoices for overage billing until customers confirm. Don't auto-charge unknown cards.
Maya: Pilot launch checklist draft: 1) Price in catalog, 2) Console purchase flow for surge pack, 3) Quota & enforcement in billing, 4) Docs + SE playbook, 5) 3 pilot customers.
Ross: Add sales guardrails: manual quota increases need AM approval for first 90 days.
Claire: Add gating: require 30 days of revenue visibility before auto-billing surge packs on new accounts.
Sanjay: Tech enforcement snippet:
```
quota: {
  per_minute_tokens: 50000,
  soft_threshold_pct: 0.95,
  fallback: 429,
  surge_pack_enabled: true
}
```
Maya: SKU shape: starter-flat + surge-pack SKU, no slabs, no seats. Simpler catalog.
Ross: Can we grant a one-time trial credit (500k tokens) for demos? Sales asks for it.
Claire: Trial credits OK but mark as non-revenue in analytics. We'll track conversion from trial to paid.
Eli: Pilot participation requirements: telemetry consent, 30-day pilot commitment, and a short eval prompt set to measure quality and cost.
Maya: Launch metrics: trial->paid conversion, avg tokens/mo, % buying surge packs, charge dispute rate, fraud incidents.
Sanjay: ETA: 3 sprints end-to-end (billing + runtime + console). Could shave to 2 sprints with minimal UI (purchase button + modal).
Maya: Prioritization tradeoff vs Optimize backlog. Ross: field requests indicate high priority — several inbound SMBs.
Claire: If we accelerate, gating must include fraud detection rules, manual review queue, and billing hold policy.
Maya: Proposed gates: fraud rules in place + 2 pilot customers + billing-hold flow ready. Then soft-launch to 200 accounts.
Ross: I'll populate pilot candidate names by EOD.
Eli: I'll draft pilot consent template and telemetry data list.
Sanjay: I'll open the runtime PR and link it here when ready.
pricing-bot: PRD published: https://redwood.internal/prd/starter-slabless — sections: pricing, enforcement, pilot-criteria, rollback-plan :bookmark_tabs:
Maya: Thanks all. Next sync Thurs 10am. I'll post the playbook in #product after lunch. :rocket:
